STRICT RULE: Absolutely no music, only diegetic sounds; nobody speaks a line, the crowd only shouts and cries out without words.
Realism cinematic, real skin with pores and small marks, natural eyes, people and set lit only by this place's named sources: the afternoon sun high on the left, falling hard across the street and onto the faces, the shopfronts under their awnings in shade; dusty gold highlights, warm natural colour; fine dust hanging in the air.
Framed on the rule of thirds, with a light anamorphic lens character: softly oval out-of-focus highlights in the background, and a fine 35mm film grain.
Image reference 1 (location Madhopur bazaar): the Madhopur bazaar 100% as in the reference.
In frame only: the market crowd of villagers, all adults: men in cotton kurtas and gamchhas, women in sarees, shopkeepers in aprons. The bazaar street runs away from the lens, shopfronts on the left, wooden stalls on the right, thin dust still hanging in the air; beyond the far end of the street lie open fields, and far off a road lined with small shops. Eyelines never at the camera.
Opening: villagers walking and standing in the dusty street among the stalls, some brushing dust from their clothes.
Nobody speaks a line in this clip: the villagers only shout and cry out without words.
The villagers are out to see what is crossing the sky; once it tears through the far fields they brace and hold on to the stalls, with resilience.
Pace: fast and rising, reactions cut against wide shots of the destruction far away, then one heavy landing and a long shaking settle.
S1 0.0-1.6s · medium, from street level among the stalls, slightly low, handheld · a knot of villagers stop mid-step and tip their heads back, hands coming up to shade their eyes, a rushing roar rising from 0.3s; the shopfronts behind them.
S2 1.6-3.6s · full, a tilt up from the awning tops to the open sky, then static · a huge blazing object wrapped in fire and black smoke tears low across the sky from upper left to lower right, its true shape hidden inside the flames, the roar peaking at 2.6s; only sky, smoke and awning tops.
S3 3.6-5.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter, slightly low, handheld · an old shopkeeper with a grey moustache tracks it across the sky, orange light sweeping over his face, his look passing right of the lens and up; panicked wordless shouts around him; a woman in a yellow saree soft behind him.
S4 5.0-7.4s · full, from the end of the street looking out over open farmland, eye level, static · far away the burning object ploughs through distant fields, ripping a long burning furrow through the crops, a wall of dust and debris climbing behind it, its shape lost in fire and smoke; small trees on the horizon; nobody in frame.
S5 7.4-8.8s · medium, from the front, eye level, handheld · three villagers duck and throw their arms over their heads as a shop window shatters behind them at 7.6s, glass falling onto the stall boards; panicked wordless cries.
S6 8.8-11.2s · full, a long-lens view down a distant road lined with small shops, eye level, static · far off the blazing object smashes low through the row of shops, tin roofs peeling away, shutters buckling and collapsing with a clatter, a plume of dust and debris rolling up behind it; nobody near enough to see.
S7 11.2-12.4s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, slightly low, static · a young man with a checked gamchha on his shoulder stares toward the horizon off left of the lens as the roar cuts out and a white-orange glow drops behind the far tree line; the dusty street behind him.
S8 12.4-16.0s · medium, from street level, eye level, handheld · one deep, heavy ground impact lands from far away at 12.6s and the picture jolts; the villagers stagger and brace against the stalls, windows rattle in their frames, dust shakes loose from the awnings and tin roofs, a loose shutter bangs; a low rumble rolls through the street and dies away by 15.5s; only villagers, stalls and shopfronts in frame.
All speech is in Hindi. Only the words inside double quotation marks are ever spoken aloud; every voice direction and every other word of this text stays silent.
No speech in S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, S7, S8.
Restrictions:
- No music of any kind: no score, no soundtrack, no background music, no melody, no drone, no pad, no sting, no swell.
- Only diegetic sound: the roar of the object, the crowd's wordless shouts and cries, shattering glass, collapsing shop shutters, one deep heavy ground impact and its low rolling rumble.
- The object's true shape stays hidden by fire, smoke and distance in every shot; no spacecraft or machine is ever seen.
- No readable words are spoken: no one on screen speaks, whispers or mouths a sentence.
